name: LangSmith
summary: LangChain's agent and LLM observability and evaluation platform: tracing, monitoring, cost and latency tracking.
description: Client SDKs: as of 2026-10-16 the `langchain-ai/langsmith-sdk` monorepo is archived; the Python SDK now lives in `langchain-ai/langsmith-python` and the JS/TS SDK in `langchain-ai/langsmith-javascript` (both MIT). Package names are unchanged (`langsmith` on PyPI and npm).
